title: Silly's Cozy RPG
description: This project focuses on the adventure and rpg aspects of modded minecraft, but with some cozy mechanics here and there
body:
This is a modpack that was made during the development of Hytale and was my atempt to satisfy the itch before it launched, with it launched and in a indevelopment state I decided to release this project to the public just to get it out there.

The core identity of the modpack is adventure and rpg that shows off Epic Fight and its addons, and with mods like Alex's Caves and Cataclysm to challenge the player. you start off with a choice of spawning in The Overworld like normal with custom tailored races to choose from or The Nether where you choose netherling/transdimensional races to survive in the nether.

Since minecraft is a cozy game at its core design I also added some decorative mods to help immerse yourself into the world with, plus some extra mods to give you some form of an economy.

There are quests but they act more like documentation than an actual questline.
